design_name: Outcome-unseen reverse transport validation on Starrydata2
status: outcome-free target metadata, components, source ranks, fixed policy orders, and hypothesis cards generated; target y values remain unopened and formal outcome access requires a verified PREOUTCOME sentinel
claim_guard: This target tests a reverse directed edge and independent OOD utility. It is retained regardless of sign. No target value, high-performing material identity, or outcome correlation was inspected before this freeze.
outcome_access_protocol: Download only the three hash-pinned files.
Read compressed CSV headers with zero data rows and archive the column list.
Freeze a schema amendment mapping composition, sample, DOI, temperature, property descriptor, units, x values, and y values.
Build and hash an outcome-free target metadata table, provenance components, OOD scopes, source predictions, policy orders, and hypothesis cards.
Only then parse and join target y values.

primary_target.condition: temperature retained explicitly; the primary condition window and aggregation rule will be fixed from descriptor and unit metadata without inspecting y values
primary_target.component: connected exact composition, sample lineage, and DOI group; a second outcome-free composition-cluster resolution is mandatory

prediction.primary_endpoint: relative RMSE reduction in the highest outcome-free OOD quartile versus target-only
representations: composition plus temperature/available structure or processing context

co_primary: acquisitions to first distinct top-5-percent component
exploration.source_increment: The adjacent ionic source must be compared with the best same-domain ESTM policy and must contribute unique high-value components to support reverse cross-domain borrowing.

specificity.abstention: Any source that fails its frozen credibility threshold receives zero weight and zero portfolio allocation.

inference.unit: paper SID/DOI and independent composition component
inference.within_target: paired group bootstrap and source-rank randomization
inference.seed_warning: Repeated target-label seeds are conditional sensitivity, not external replication.
